title: phyllanthus niruri var. amarus
intro: Phyllanthus niruri var. amarus, commonly known as Chanca piedra, is a plant species that belongs to the family Phyllanthaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including kidney stones and liver disease, due to its health benefits, which include its ability to prevent the formation of kidney stones, improve liver function, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Chanca piedra include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic properties, which help to alleviate symptoms associated with kidney stones and liver disease. The bioactive constituents of Chanca piedra include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
